title: EZSTAF — AI Recruitment & Applicant Platform
summary: An AI-enabled recruitment platform with an LLM chatbot, MCP tools, and vector-based candidate matching.
description: EZSTAF is an end-to-end recruitment platform streamlining applicant and recruiter workflows. Built with a cross-platform Flutter mobile client and a high-performance Python FastAPI backend, it integrates a Mistral-powered chatbot with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and RAG candidate matching using Sentence Transformers and Pinecone.
keyFeatures: LLM-powered recruitment chatbot for candidates and recruiters using Mistral and MCP servers
AI job-matching and candidate ranking powered by Sentence Transformers embeddings and Pinecone
End-to-end job application submission, tracking, and interview coordination workflows
Layered Flutter/Dart client architecture communicating via typed RESTful JSON contracts
FastAPI asynchronous backend with complex PostgreSQL schemas and foreign-key relationships
Global search powered by Elasticsearch and cloud storage with Neon PostgreSQL
architectureDetails: AI / LLM Layer: Mistral LLM connected to MCP tools for tool-calling recruitment workflows
Vector Search: Sentence Transformers embeddings with Pinecone vector database for RAG retrieval
Mobile Client: Layered Flutter/Dart architecture with responsive multi-role screens
Backend API: Asynchronous FastAPI endpoints with Pydantic validation schemas
Database Store: Neon PostgreSQL relational schemas with foreign-key dependencies

title: Applicant Management System
summary: A full-featured recruitment platform organizing applicant records, job postings, interview scheduling, and candidate progress.
description: A centralized management system engineered to organize candidate pipelines, manage applicant profiles, schedule evaluation rounds, and track decisions across recruitment stages. Built with a modular React frontend and a FastAPI backend with relational PostgreSQL storage.
keyFeatures: Centralized candidate profile repository with complete applicant history
Job posting creation, lifecycle management, and publishing
Multi-stage interview scheduling and candidate evaluation tracking
FastAPI REST endpoints with request/response handling through defined JSON contracts
Relational PostgreSQL schema with foreign-key dependencies and indexing
architectureDetails: Frontend: Responsive React dashboard with modular component hierarchy
API Layer: RESTful endpoints with Pydantic input/output schemas
Data Store: PostgreSQL relational database with foreign key constraints and indexes

title: AI-Powered Knowledge & Semantic Search
summary: A project concept demonstrating how text can be converted into dense embeddings to power semantic vector search and contextual retrieval.
description: A project prototype demonstrating vector-based semantic retrieval. It takes text documents, generates dense numerical embeddings using Sentence Transformers, indexes the vectors in Pinecone, and enables natural language similarity queries that go beyond exact keyword matching.
keyFeatures: Dense text vector generation using open-source Sentence Transformer models
Vector indexing and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) retrieval in Pinecone
Natural language semantic query matching surpassing lexical keyword search
FastAPI endpoint for document ingestion, embedding, and vector querying
Cosine similarity scoring for contextual relevance evaluation
architectureDetails: Embedding Model: Sentence Transformers model running locally for inference
Vector Store: Pinecone cloud index with cosine distance metric
API Gateway: FastAPI microservice exposing search and ingestion endpoints

title: Data Engineering Pipeline
summary: A data engineering project demonstrating ingestion, transformation, validation, and analytics-ready data processing.
description: A data engineering template demonstrating structured data processing workflows. Demonstrates ingesting raw dataset files from AWS S3, applying schema validation and business logic transformations using Python and SQL, and loading analytics-ready tables into Snowflake.
keyFeatures: Raw data staging and batch ingestion from cloud object storage (AWS S3)
Declarative SQL and Python data transformations for schema standardization
Automated data validation checks for null values, duplicates, and type consistency
Snowflake warehouse architecture design for analytical querying
Snowpark and PySpark compatibility for scalable distributed execution
architectureDetails: Storage: AWS S3 raw staging bucket
Transformation Engine: SQL transformations and Python scripts (Snowpark / PySpark)
Data Warehouse: Snowflake structured tables optimized for analytical reporting
